subject: Novosolutions - trial conversion options and extension request
messages:
From: Sanjay Reddy <sanjay.reddy@novosolutions.com>
To: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Nair <aisha.nair@novosolutions.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Apr 2028 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Trial wrap & request: convert unused days to eng hours?

Hi Dev,

Quick note following our internal review of the pilot run rate — we expect to have ~16 unused evaluation days remaining in the sandbox window. We hit product / data gating faster than anticipated and would like to explore two paths:

1) Short extension (2–3 weeks) to finish a repeatability pass, or
2) Convert the unused days into engineering support hours (onsite/remote) we can consume as onboarding work for production lift.

Budget for the pilot is constrained and procurement prefers credits/engineering hours over a straight time extension (hard to justify another timebox). Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- convert unused trial days to a pool of engineering hours (how many hours per day conversion, discount?)
- or alternatively provide a short extension with minimal fee?

I've attached the current SOW for context. If we can agree a simple mechanism, I can route to procurement quickly.

Thanks,
Sanjay Reddy
Head of ML Platforms
NovoSolutions

Attachment: Novosolutions_SOW_v1.pdf

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Reddy <sanjay.reddy@novosolutions.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Apr 2028 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial wrap & request: convert unused days to eng hours?

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the clear note and the SOW. Short answer: yes, we can do either; below are three pragmatic options (we try to make procurement + legal easy):

Option A — Extension (no conversion): 21 calendar days extension at no charge if Novo commits to a 3-month paid pilot within 30 days of the extension end.

Option B — Conversion to Eng Hours (preferred by Procurement): convert unused trial days to a block of Redwood Solutions Engineering hours. We propose 1 day = 6 SE hours. For the ~16 days you mentioned that would be 96 hours. We can price those hours at a 22% discount off standard SE rate and include a 30-day expiry. We can bake this into a one-page addendum.

Option C — Credit: convert unused days to a dollar credit equal to the prorated per-day run-rate (no add-on hours), usable towards invoices in 90 days.

I've drafted a short addendum that implements Option B (attached) so procurement has something to review. Jordan — want to confirm that 6 hours/day conversion is the right mapping for our SE playbook?

If you prefer, we can also do a hybrid (some credit + some hours). I looped in Marissa (sales lead) to sign off on discount authority.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: addendum_conversion_draft.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Reddy <sanjay.reddy@novosolutions.com>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Apr 2028 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial wrap & request: convert unused days to eng hours?

Hi Sanjay — quick note from me:

We can approve Option B (conversion to SE hours) per the draft, with one commercial caveat: if Novo converts now we can extend the expiry on the hours to 60 days provided Novo commits to a minimum 3-month reserved capacity order (discounted) or a single purchase order for expansion within 90 days.

If procurement needs a pure extension instead of conversion, we can do the 21-day extension at no charge but would need a soft commitment (email OK) to either a paid pilot or a purchase intent so we can justify the concession internally.

I'll authorize up to 25% discount on SE day rates if there's a signed PO or LOI. Otherwise the standard cap is 22%.

Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions Sales (North America)
Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Reddy <sanjay.reddy@novosolutions.com>
To: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aisha Nair <aisha.nair@novosolutions.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2028 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial wrap & request: convert unused days to eng hours?

Dev / Marissa — thanks. Procurement prefers Option B (hours) but they've asked if Redwood can move to 25% discount on SE rates. We're coming off a constrained budget this quarter; procurement also needs the conversion mechanism to be contractually simple (one-page addendum + PO).

Aisha (cc'd) — I'm attaching our PO template so you have the procurement fields we need in the invoice/DocuSign.

On tradeoffs: we would rather have usable hours than a time extension. The extra lead time for a 3-month commitment would be a blocker for our CFO.

Sanjay

On Mon, Apr 15, 2028 at 11:22 AM Sanjay Reddy <sanjay.reddy@novosolutions.com> wrote:
> Dev / Marissa — thanks. Procurement prefers Option B (hours) but they've asked if Redwood can move to 25% discount on SE rates.

Thanks for the clarity, Sanjay. We can meet in the middle: Redwood will accept 25% discount on the converted SE hours if Novo issues a PO covering the converted hours within 5 business days and signs the one-page addendum via DocuSign. The hours will be valid for 60 days from the DocuSign signing date.

Mechanics (quick):
- Conversion: 1 trial day = 6 SE hours -> ~96 hours for the 16 unused days.
- Rate: standard SE day $3,000 -> hourly baseline $375 -> with 25% discount $281.25/hr -> total converted value ~ $27,000 (invoiced as net line item).
- Addendum: short DocuSign link below; invoice will reference PO# once issued.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/abcdef1234567890
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765

Jordan — please confirm SE availability windows so we can include a recommended schedule in the addendum.

If procurement confirms the PO, I'll spin the DocuSign and loop legal for a one-line acceptance.

Best,
Dev Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
